sum: Mobility Global, Inc. provides automotive data, insights, and technology solutions in the United States and internationally. It operates in two segments, CARFAX and Business-to-Business (B2B). The CARFAX segment provides consumers, dealers, car service providers, and finance and insurance with vehicle history, valuations, listings, and service reminders through proprietary data estate and brand to help consumers buy the right car at the right price, sell, and maintain vehicles. The B2B segment delivers data, forecasts, and sales and marketing solutions for product planning, supply-chain and technology decisions, market analytics, pricing and incentives, and targeted customer activation to original equipment manufacturers, suppliers, dealers, and finance and insurance markets. This segment also provides suite of solutions, including automotiveMastermind, Polk Auto Solutions, Market Scan, various market reporting tools, and Data Studio platform, as well as vehicle and supply chain forecasting, and global reporting. It sells its products through subscription and non-subscription transactions. The company was formerly known as S&P Global Mobility Holding Company and changed its name to Mobility Global, Inc. in February 2026. The company was incorporated in 2025 and is based in Centreville, Virginia.
